resources.string: Lets 小满Extra operate other apps for you

小满Extra uses this service to read the screen, take screenshots and tap, swipe and type in other apps when you ask it to do a task. The screen content is sent only to the AI model you configured. Payments, sending messages and other sensitive steps always ask for your confirmation, and you can stop a task at any time with the Stop button.
Stop the current 小满Extra task
Pause 小满Extra so you can operate the phone yourself
Let 小满Extra continue the task
